proposed_capability: Local, bounded, replay-resistant online estimates for verified Sims region traversal time and failure; attach learned advisory edge costs to the existing deterministic household navigation planner without adding an actuator, desktop crawler, save mutation, or camera-as-Sim-motion confusion.
player_save_control_impact: Explicit opt-in existing host listener only; accepted host or reviewed source-provenance transition with two different capture references, no player interruption, and same exact scene/graph/scope. Persist only bounded aggregate edge statistics and hashed event identities in canonical user-scoped BetterInstincts runtime; never read/modify Sims saves, mouse settings, raw captures or EA files. Predictions never grant game effects.

strategic_theses.falsification: Sparse unverified native feedback, duplicate control ownership and no Sims live certification make action-policy learning premature

strategic_theses.thesis: Expand SLAM/visual model as first learning gate
strategic_theses.falsification: Spatial perception already has an independent PR #159 owner; camera and geometry perception do not explain observed passage latency/failure

strategic_theses.thesis: Tune static Dijkstra graph costs manually
strategic_theses.falsification: Manual edits cannot adapt to repeated route outcomes and encourage unproven assumptions

strategic_theses.thesis: Bounded evidence-gated online edge cost learner attached to existing graph
strategic_theses.falsification: Without instrumented independent events it has no live learning; preserve baseline until evidence and explicitly report adapter coverage

selected_thesis: P141 chooses replay-resistant per-profile observed-edge cost learning; P95 defines the route-observation-scoring stack and failure seams, P82 evaluates deterministic route-choice changes, P08 remains local-Sims blocked, P07 implements and tests safely, P124 integrates within existing owners.
investigation: Prototype two verified alternative paths with explicit baseline passage timing; feed distinct success/failure events, compare prequential route choice before/after, reject absent/stale/duplicate data. Human/game effect gate unchanged.
expected_outcome: Opt-in active sessions progressively update local bounded model; exact save/lot/patch/graph scope prevents leakage; planner can rank a verified, cheaper alternative using shrunk latency and failure estimates; direct native actions, anti-WALK-spam, camera separation, player priority and no-effect receipts remain intact.
negative_tests: No explicit listener opt-in or active session refuses writes
Unknown/camera-only/unreviewed source and stale scene or player interruption refuse learning
Replay across processes does not change aggregate
No sensor evidence, invalid learned model or missing expected timing preserves safe baseline
Failures raise bounded cost but never create edges or grant clicks
Concurrent writers cannot silently lose updates
Outcomes are not fabricated from a walk or camera pan
Dijkstra ties, budget, goal actions and player queue remain unchanged
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; locally retained optional model profiles can be manually deleted by user; no game saves, controller permissions or preexisting model schema changed.
unresolved_unknowns: No accessible installed Sims 4 game host or verified native route callback through this GitHub provider
PR #159 separately owns raw sensors; this sprint cannot implement or certify them
Real travel-time metrics and model calibration require opt-in instrumented local sessions and EA exact-build evidence
BI-002 hunger live gameplay certification remains active
decision_rationale: High leverage with existing graph and VOI; conservatively measurable and reversible; no claim of VIO SLAM camera precision from unobserved samples.
